articles.title: GBP/USD climbs as Bessent softens US stance, Powell’s dovish tilt

articles.author: Christian Borjon Valencia
articles.summary: Banco de Mexico (Banxico) Deputy Governor Jonathan Heath crossed the newswires in a podcast by Grupo Financiero Banorte on Wednesday.
articles.title: Banxico Deputy Governor urges caution on rate cuts amid sticky inflation

articles.author: Vishal Chaturvedi
articles.summary: The Japanese Yen (JPY) trades on the front foot against the US Dollar (USD) on Wednesday, with USD/JPY extending losses for a second straight day as the Greenback weakens under pressure from escalating US-China trade tensions and a dovish Federal Reserve (Fed) outlook.
articles.title: USD/JPY retreats as Greenback weakens on trade tensions, Fed easing bets and US fiscal gridlock

articles.author: Ghiles Guezout
articles.summary: USD/CAD trims losses on Wednesday, back around 1.4040 at the time of writing, after hitting an intraday low of 1.4026. More broadly, the US Dollar (USD) is consolidating against the Canadian Dollar (CAD) after peaking near 1.4080 on Tuesday.
articles.title: US Dollar retreats against Canadian Dollar as Fed signals rate cuts, Oil caps CAD recovery

articles.author: Agustin Wazne
articles.summary: Federal Reserve Governor Stephen Miran spoke at the Nomura Research Forum in Washington, DC. He stated that AI investment could lead to a higher neutral interest rate, and that recent policy changes, including immigration, have resulted in rapid shifts in the neutral rate.
articles.title: Fed’s Miran: Current fed policy is more restrictive than people think because the neutral rate has fallen

articles.author: Ghiles Guezout
articles.summary: Silver (XAG/USD) resumes its rally on Wednesday, trading around $52.40 per troy ounce at the time of writing, up 2.40% on the day, as investors seek safety amid renewed global tensions and growing expectations of additional monetary easing by the US Federal Reserve (Fed).
articles.title: Silver rallies on safe-haven demand amid US-China tensions, Fed rate cut bets

articles.author: Joshua Gibson
articles.summary: The Dow Jones Industrial Average (DJIA) found room on the high side on Wednesday, climbing into a second day of recovery flows and testing territory north of 46,600 before settling back to flat for the day.
articles.title: Dow Jones Industrial Average flattens after earnings boost shaky market sentiment

articles.author: Vishal Chaturvedi
articles.summary: The New Zealand Dollar (NZD) remains on the defensive against the US Dollar (USD) on Wednesday, extending its losing streak to a seventh consecutive session as investors continue to punish the Kiwi despite a broadly weaker Greenback.
articles.title: NZD/USD extends losses amid RBNZ’s dovish stance and US-China trade tensions

articles.author: Pablo Piovano
articles.summary: The US Dollar (USD) added to its weekly correction, briefly slipping back to multi-day lows on the back of the renewed offered stance, a better tone in the risk complex and persistent bets on rate cuts by the Fed in the latter part of the year.
articles.title: FX Today: Australian jobs report and UK GDP data come to the fore

articles.author: Christian Borjon Valencia
articles.summary: Gold (XAU/USD) price rallies for the fourth consecutive trading day on Wednesday, up by more than 1.40% and hitting a record high of $4,218 as the trade-war escalates and geopolitical uncertainty pushes investors to the safe-haven metal.
articles.title: Gold rallies past $4,200 on safe-haven rush amid US political, trade chaos

articles.author: FXStreet Team
articles.summary: Australia’s Unemployment Rate climbed to 4.5% in September from 4.3% in August (revised from 4.2%), according to the official data released by the Australian Bureau of Statistics (ABS) on Thursday. The figure came in above the market consensus of 4.3%.
articles.title: Australia’s Unemployment Rate jumps to 4.5% in September vs. 4.3% expected

articles.title: Australia National Australia Bank's Business Confidence (QoQ): 7 (3Q) vs -1

articles.author: Christian Borjon Valencia
articles.summary: EUR/USD traded with gains on Wednesday, up by 0.35% and above the 1.1600 figure for the second straight day as the Greenback is pressured by firm expectations of rate cuts by the Federal Reserve and the escalation of the trade-war between the US and China.
articles.title: EUR/USD surges above 1.16 on Fed dovish bets, trade-war woes

articles.author: Lallalit Srijandorn
articles.summary: The USD/JPY pair tumbles to around 150.85 during the early Asian session on Thursday. The US Dollar (USD) weakens against the Japanese Yen (JPY) due to the continuing trade tensions between the US and China.
articles.title: USD/JPY slumps below 151.00 amid ongoing US-China trade tensions

articles.author: Joshua Gibson
articles.summary: GBP/USD found room on the high side on Wednesday, clawing its way back to the 1.3400 handle after a near-term dip into the low end that saw Cable briefly battle the 200-day Exponential Moving Average (EMA) near 1.3290.
articles.title: GBP/USD shrugs off bearish momentum, recovers 1.3400 region
